cleanup.scope: Four superseded executables and one prior Vortex reference; original source, current runtime/reference, released control and all result/evidence records retained.

clocks.native_boundary: native process creation through complete output and process exit
clocks.workflow_boundary: Guarded ingest launch through final query validation/archive; includes supervision and intervening checks, excludes initial source/reference hashes and final complete-artifact hash.

controls.memory_policy: 24 GiB admission is not physical RAM or an enforced RSS cap.
controls.ordinary_desktop_activity: Observed; not stopped. OS ps snapshots do not establish exclusive CPU attribution.

ingest_counters.cpu_timing_boundary: native child CPU work; parallel work overlaps wall time
ingest_counters.os_counter_scope: native child getrusage counters; block operations are not bytes; platform accounting varies
ingest_counters.timing_boundary: native process creation through complete output and process exit

limits: Single-pass observation, not paired speedup, best-of-three score, cold-cache claim or official ClickBench ranking.
Post-release merged-main runtime, not a remeasurement of published 0.3.3 distributions.
Lower timings are consistent with contention; these observations do not identify its cause.
Retained exact results are regression evidence, not a new independent SQL oracle.
Broader PERF/CG gates and paused format tests are unchanged.
protocol: One fresh public Parquet-to-Vortex preparation followed by one sequential complete Q1-Q43 pass.
